title: New link-queue vocabulary gate scans only app/ though render-path code lives in harness/ too
evidence:
+HITS=$(grep -rnE 'link_(queue|depth|backlog|buffer|load|congest)' app/ --include='*.odin' || true)
+if [ -n "$HITS" ]; then echo "$HITS"; echo "FAIL: link-queue vocabulary on a render path (spine F5/AD-1)"; FAIL=1; fi

--- harness/palcheck.odin hunk in this same diff:
 		// camera: both pipes on screen, bands wide enough for clean sampling
 		view.scale = 2.0
 		view.lane_detail = false
detail: The gate's stated purpose is 'no link-queue vocabulary on render paths', but its scope is app/ only — harness/palcheck.odin, a render path this very diff edits (camera, view, frame sampling), escapes the check.
recommended_fix: Extend the grep to the render surfaces that exist outside app/ (harness/ render fixtures, tools/ render checks), or narrow the gate's comment to say app/ render paths only.
